reason: Owner approved a tighter baseline on 2026-11-04 to preserve the renderer entry reductions. The measured v0.7.6 release replaces v0.7.4 and its accepted growth exceptions, while retaining the 20,000-byte growth allowance.

measurement.metric: Uncompressed bytes of the single JavaScript entry identified by isEntry in out/renderer/renderer-chunks.json, checked against the emitted file size as in guard-renderer-bundle.mjs. CSS, dynamic chunks and source maps are excluded.
measurement.method: The integration owner built the unmodified v0.7.6 release tag in /tmp/vomp-measure-076 on 2026-11-05 with a verified node_modules symlink and npx electron-vite build. The measurement command selected the single isEntry chunk from emitted renderer metadata, checked its bytes against stat on the emitted file and verified the commit and lockfile checksum. The original /tmp/vomp-v076-measure result was discarded: worktree creation had copied a node_modules directory, so ln -s created a nested link instead of replacing that directory. The copied dependency tree produced a different entry. The diagnostic scratch worktree was removed; the integration owner owns cleanup of /tmp/vomp-measure-076. No Electron process was launched.
commandsRun: git rev-parse HEAD && shasum -a 256 package-lock.json && node --input-type=module -e 'import { readFile, stat } from "node:fs/promises"; import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path"; const path = "out/renderer/renderer-chunks.json"; const metadata = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8")); const entries = metadata.chunks.filter(chunk => chunk.isEntry); if (entries.length !== 1) throw new Error(`Expected one entry, received ${entries.length}`); const entry = entries[0]; const size = (await stat(resolve(dirname(path), entry.fileName))).size; if (size !== entry.bytes) throw new Error("Entry file size disagrees with metadata"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ entryFile: entry.fileName, entryBytes: entry.bytes, emittedBytes: size }, null, 2));'
cleanReproduction: node --input-type=module -e 'import { readFile, stat } from "node:fs/promises"; import { resolve } from "node:path"; const root="/tmp/vomp-classic-baseline/out/renderer"; const metadata=JSON.parse(await readFile(resolve(root,"renderer-chunks.json"),"utf8")); const entries=metadata.chunks.filter(chunk=>chunk.isEntry); if(entries.length!==1) throw new Error("Expected one renderer entry"); const entry=entries[0]; const bytes=(await stat(resolve(root,entry.fileName))).size; if(bytes!==entry.bytes) throw new Error("Entry file size disagrees with metadata"); console.log(entry.fileName,bytes);'
